title: Person
description: An individual such as an owner, tenant, council member, or contact. Only include personal information that the exchanging parties are entitled to share.
x-validationRules: Implementations must not require email or phone; many exchanges should omit them entirely.

mailingAddress.description: Mailing address for notices, if different from the unit address.
